FIELDS.NAME: ValueMart
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Inspection Coordinator, ValueMart, 123 Oak Street, Suite 100, Springfield, IL 62704-5678, (555) 123-4567
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ValueMart operates as a retail department store providing a wide array of products, including clothing, home goods, electronics, and beauty products, catering to a diverse customer base. Our store is strategically located in a suburban shopping center, ensuring steady foot traffic and consistent sales. We prioritize customer service and safety through documented employee training programs and dedicated security staff. As a responsible retailer, we manage our inventory effectively and maintain compliance with all local, state, and federal regulations. We do not conduct any on-premises food preparation or extensive repair operations, enabling us to focus primarily on our retail activities. Our operational model limits incidental repair services to well below the permissible threshold, ensuring alignment with industry standards and practices.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: ValueMart Retail Solutions, LLC - A small retail consulting business that provides strategic advice to department stores and discount retailers on inventory management and marketing strategies.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Theft of electronics on 03/12/2023, caused by a break-in; amount $5,000; status resolved.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday: 9:00 AM - 9:00 PM; Sunday: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Fire-resistant safe, Class B, UL listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and on-site security personnel for theft prevention and safety measures.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – ValueMart does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. Our retail operations focus purely on selling products without involvement in hazardous material activities.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – ValueMart does not sponsor any athletic teams as part of its operations or community involvement.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are checked by the designated inspection coordinator to ensure compliance.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – ValueMart has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. The company maintains a strong commitment to ethical practices and compliance with all regulations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – ValueMart has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. We maintain a consistent insurance history with our previous carrier.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – ValueMart does not lease employees to or from other employers; all staff are directly employed by the company.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – ValueMart carries Workers’ Compensation insurance to comply with statutory requirements and ensure employee protection.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – ValueMart also owns and operates "ValueMart Retail Solutions, LLC," a small retail consulting business that provides strategic advice to other retailers on inventory management and marketing strategies.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – ValueMart currently does not have any other insurance policies with this company aside from the existing coverage noted in the application.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – ValueMart is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on retail sales of diverse product categories.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – ValueMart does not rent or loan equipment to others as part of its retail operations; our focus is solely on selling products directly to customers.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – ValueMart has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years, maintaining a stable financial status.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – ValueMart does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations focus solely on retail sales without involvement in hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – ValueMart does not have any catastrophe exposure, as our operations are strictly focused on retail sales with no involvement in high-risk activities or environments.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – ValueMart has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The company maintains a strong commitment to ethical practices and compliance with regulations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – ValueMart has no uncorrected fire code violations and maintains compliance with all relevant fire safety regulations.
